newsitem.title: INDIA: World Gold Council to hold conference in New Delhi.
newsitem.headline: World Gold Council to hold conference in New Delhi.

text.p: The World Gold Council (WGC) said it will host the first-ever gold economic conference to be held in India in New Delhi on November 28 and 29.
In a statement on Thursday, the WGC said India had been chosen as the conference venue because of its importance as the world's largest consumer of gold.
The focus of the conference would be on India's existing gold policy and the emphasis would be placed on asset management and investment options.
Delegates would examine policy regimes in countries that had benefited from a liberalised gold economy through case studies.

Topics to be covered in the conference included an overview of the economic and business environment in India in relation to the gold industry, present and future trends in gold markets and the role of banks in mobilising gold.
